en:
Use "Rival Club" files to play matches
in the tournament and match format
you have set.

Create an original club to use in the
@Y/"Best Players Match"@ mode.

Take a "Rival Club" file through a
knockout run to test how strong
that club really is.

Set the tournament type and match
format for these matches.

Use a ready-made format.
Press Left/Right to select.

Play a knockout tournament.
The default is 4 participating clubs.

Play a league.
The default is 4 participating clubs.

Use a format from world tournaments.
There are two main types.

Set the number of clubs and the format
(league, knockout, etc.).

Play a match between the
@Y/two clubs@ taking part.

@Y/4 clubs@ take part in a
@K/knockout tournament@.

@Y/8 clubs@ take part in a
@K/knockout tournament@.

@Y/16 clubs@ take part in a
@K/knockout tournament@.

@Y/32 clubs@ take part in a
@K/knockout tournament@.

24 clubs take part: a @Y/4-club group
league@ and a @K/16-club knockout
stage@.

32 clubs take part: a @Y/4-club group
league@ and a @K/16-club knockout
stage@.

Set whether there is extra time,
golden goal and penalties here.

Matches are played over 90 minutes
(two halves of 45) only. If the scores
are level, the match is a draw.

If level after 90 minutes, 30 minutes
of extra time are played in total. If
still level, the match is a draw.

If level after 90 minutes, 30 minutes
of extra time are played in total. If
still level, penalties decide it.

If level after 90 minutes, extra time
with the golden goal rule is played.
If still level, the match is a draw.

If level after 90 minutes, extra time
with the golden goal rule is played.
If still level, penalties are taken.

Set whether a tie is decided over one
match or over home and away
matches.

The two clubs each play at their own
home stadium, and the result over the
two matches decides the winner.

A single match decides the winner. The
match is played at a neutral stadium
unrelated to either club.

Set the entry conditions for the
tournament. Restrict entry by the age
and nationality of a club's players.

There are no entry restrictions.
Any club may take part.

Clubs with an @Y/Edit Player@ are
not allowed to take part.

Only clubs whose players are all
@Y/Japanese@ may take part.

Only clubs whose players are all
@Y/aged 19 or under@ may take part.

Only clubs whose players are all
@Y/aged 21 or under@ may take part.

Only clubs whose players are all
@Y/aged 23 or under@ may take part.

Only clubs whose players are all
@Y/aged 30 or over@ may take part.

Only clubs whose players are all
@Y/aged 35 or over@ may take part.

Select the clubs to take part. Choose
from the "Rival Club" files on the VMU
in the socket.

Finish registering clubs. The remaining
entry slots are filled from clubs that
have been set in advance.

Choose the remaining clubs for the
tournament from the preset clubs.

Have the computer automatically choose
the remaining clubs for the tournament
from the preset clubs.

Select the region and rank of
clubs to enter the tournament.

Overseas clubs among the
strongest in the world.

Overseas clubs, a little weaker than
"Overseas A" but still among the top
sides in the world.

Overseas clubs of middling
strength by world standards.

A club in J1 at the start of
the game.

A club in J2 at the start of
the game.
Stop adding clubs to the tournament.

Finish registering clubs. The remaining
entry slots are filled from clubs that
have been set in advance.

This is the tournament draw. To change
the draw, select "Redraw".

Group matches can end in a 90-minute
draw. Knockout ties go to extra time,
then penalties until decided.

Group matches can end in a 90-minute
draw. Knockout ties go to golden goal
extra time, then penalties.

Each club may register up to 5 foreign
players, and up to 3 of them may play
in a match at the same time.
